snippet.title: Escape from Fortress Lugohm Trailer
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce that Escape from Fortress Lugohm developed by baron sengia will officially release on the 16th of August, 2019! Prepare for the release by watching the trailer and adding the game to your wishlist.

Escape from Fortress Lugohm will release on August 16 on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015750/Escape_from_Fortress_Lugohm/
